title: Machine-Readable Schemas and PSTF Bundles
intent: Publish machine-readable JSON schemas for Bahia desired-state, deployment-unit, command-receipt, and reconcile-policy payloads, and package PSTF maturity-slice acceptance evidence with rollout gates, metrics, and rollback criteria.
observed_repository_state: internal/domain/runtime_desired_state.go defines DesiredServiceSpec, DesiredEnvironmentPlan, DesiredDeploymentUnitPlan, and schema version 2.
internal/domain/deployment_unit.go defines DeploymentUnit, ReconcileMode, OwnershipMode, runtime targeting normalization, and validation.
internal/api/dto/command_receipt.go defines the canonical command receipt DTO returned by Nostr-backed control-plane writes.
internal/domain/models.go stores desired runtime state, drift status, reconcile failure metadata, backoff, and last reconciliation timestamps.
